# dusk-curves fixtures v1: BLS12-381 point encodings under the acceptance rules
# of dusk-bls12_381 0.16. Never change an entry; new behaviour gets a new
# version directory.
#
# <group> <encoding> <checked> <unchecked> <name> <hex input>
#
# checked    from_compressed and Serializable::from_bytes, or from_uncompressed:
#            accept | reject
# unchecked  from_compressed_unchecked or from_uncompressed_unchecked:
#            accept | reject | dusk, accepted by the dusk backend only: its
#            uncompressed decoder skips the curve check, which blst cannot skip
#
# Every accepted input re-encodes to the same bytes. The blst backend archives
# a point as its compressed encoding and validates it like from_compressed.
